description: Estimate public USD starting costs. For product inspection in China, estimate standard warehouse sample checks or request a supplier-site quote before shipment. Use the first-job planner for the report deadline; prep: units for one job or prepDeliveryUnits for a split-delivery comparison; standalone pick-pack: orders. For one tracked customer parcel use fulfillment with parcel.country instead of orders. Add parcel.packedWeightGrams for a price, or omit the weight to get a quote link without a price. Storage: cubicMeters and either storageDays or months (30 days each), plus alreadyStoredDays when the batch is not new. For distinct receiving dates, pass batches with cubicMeters, storageDays and optional alreadyStoredDays for each receipt. The same batch gets 90 free days, not a new grace period. Yanwen parcel rates include standard pick-pack: do not add the standalone fee. Sourcing is quote-only. This does not quote, bill, purchase or ship.

alreadyStoredDays.description: Days already elapsed since actual receipt of this same batch. Defaults to zero for a new batch.

batches.description: One entry per actual receiving batch, with volume and planned additional days. Use this instead of top-level storage quantities.

cubicMeters.description: Estimated stored volume in CBM, up to three decimal places; not a warehouse measurement.

inspectionLocation.description: Where the goods will be checked. Use supplier_site for a pre-shipment visit at the factory. Only standard checks at the PrepPort warehouse have a published starting rate.

months.description: Total planned duration in 30-day periods. Do not also provide storageDays.

parcel.description: One tracked customer parcel. Use instead of orders; standard handling is included.

packedWeightGrams.description: Whole grams including the outer packaging. Omit when unknown to receive a destination-specific quote link.

prepDeliveryUnits.description: Units per planned prep delivery, instead of units. Compare combined and separate work minimums.

sampleChecks.description: Number of agreed standard sample checks at the warehouse. For a supplier-site visit, you can give the count if known and request a separate quote.

service.description: Choose sourcing, inspection, prep, storage or fulfillment.

storageDays.description: Planned additional storage days. Prefer days for precise free-period estimates.
